snippet.title: Roz Subah Do Farishton Ki Dua! Aap Kis Mein Hain? | Sahih Bukhari 1442 #shorts
snippet.description:
Roz subah, aasman se do farishte utarte hain... aur jaante hain woh kya dua karte hain?

Hazrat Abu Huraira Radi Allahu Anhu bayan karte hain, ke Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: har subah do farishte utarte hain.
«اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِ مُنْفِقًا خَلَفًا»
"Aye Allah! Kharch karne wale ko us ka badla ata farma."
«اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِ مُمْسِكًا تَلَفًا»
"Aye Allah! Rok kar rakhne wale ka maal barbaad kar de."

Reference
• Sahih al-Bukhari 1442: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:1442
• Sahih Muslim 1010: https://sunnah.com/muslim:1010

To aaj aap kis dua mein shamil honge? Chahe das rupay hon, aaj kuch de dein. Comment mein likhein: aaj maine sadqah diya! Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
